Container.Name: CrowdSec-Threat-Map
Container.Overview: CrowdSec Threat Map displays local CrowdSec alerts on an interactive world map with a live feed, English/French UI, larger readable text, CSV export, themes, optional unban support and optional dynamic whitelist support. Mount your CrowdSec database read-only for a safe dashboard-only setup.

Config.Name: WebUI - HTTP host port
Config.Description: Host port for the CrowdSec Threat Map web dashboard.

Config.Name: Paths - CrowdSec data
Config.Description: CrowdSec data directory containing crowdsec.db and optionally GeoLite2-City.mmdb. Keep read-only for dashboard-only deployments.

Config.Name: Paths - CrowdSec postoverflows
Config.Description: Optional CrowdSec postoverflows directory. Required only if WHITELIST_ENABLED=true.

Config.Name: Paths - Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional Docker socket. Required only for dashboard unban or dynamic whitelist CrowdSec restart actions.

Config.Name: Core - SERVER_LAT
Config.Description: Server marker latitude. Example for Paris: 48.8566.

Config.Name: Core - SERVER_LON
Config.Description: Server marker longitude. Example for Paris: 2.3522.

Config.Name: Core - SERVER_NAME
Config.Description: Display name for the server marker.

Config.Name: CrowdSec - Container name
Config.Description: CrowdSec Docker container name. Used only when Docker socket access is mounted for unban/whitelist actions.

Config.Name: CrowdSec - Dynamic whitelist enabled
Config.Description: Enable only if the postoverflows path is mounted read-write and Docker socket access is intentionally enabled.

Config.Name: CrowdSec - Whitelist file
Config.Description: Whitelist YAML path inside the container.

Config.Name: CrowdSec - Whitelist interval
Config.Description: How often the public IP is checked for dynamic whitelist updates, in seconds.

Config.Name: CrowdSec - Restart wait
Config.Description: Wait time after restarting CrowdSec for whitelist updates.

Config.Name: CrowdSec - Restart cooldown
Config.Description: Minimum time between automatic CrowdSec restarts for whitelist updates.

Config.Name: CrowdSec - Unban API token
Config.Description: Recommended when /unban is enabled. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Leave empty only on trusted LAN deployments.

Config.Name: Data - Days back
Config.Description: How many days of CrowdSec alert history to display.
